record.hypothesis: Add a residual feed-forward block after every GRU output: h' = h + W2(GELU(W1(h))), with widths 128→256→128 and W2 initialized to zero. This starts from the incumbent recurrent representation while allowing jointly trained nonlinear compatibility with item embeddings. Apply identically in training and inference across all four datasets. Preserve unit-normalized tied embeddings, history policy, final-real-position readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer; update the predictor writer for checkpoint compatibility.

category_rationales.rationale: Add a jointly trained residual feed-forward block after each GRU output, with default widths 128→256→128 and a zero-initialized output projection. This initially preserves the recurrent representation while allowing nonlinear refinement. Apply identically during training and inference across all four datasets. Preserve normalized tied embeddings, final-real-position readout, dot-product scoring, loss, optimizer and training limits. The predictor writer already imports GRU4RecModel from train.py,
